first_impression.reaction: I went to the FAQ first, as I always do, and it didn't oversell. Then the intro said "unranked" and "honest about the trade-offs", which is the opposite of the usual top-10 fluff, so I kept going. Every weather figure names its station and period, so I can check them myself. There's no pricing section, but this is a destinations piece, so I wasn't really expecting one.

journey.quote: The ten wedding destinations in August below are unranked, split by hemisphere and honest about the trade-offs.
journey.reaction: Good. No 'best', no ranking. Tells me what the list is and what it isn't.

journey.section: How we chose these ten August destinations
journey.quote: A city station can differ from a villa nearby, and averaging periods and rain-day definitions vary between countries, so read each figure on its own rather than comparing destinations directly.
journey.reaction: This is the sort of caveat I'd add myself in a spreadsheet. They're telling me the limits of their own data. That earns trust.

journey.section: How we chose these ten August destinations
journey.quote: Every place here is one we plan and write about, and the list is unranked
journey.reaction: 'One we plan' is a claim with nothing behind it on this page. How many weddings, where? I'll let it go, but I noticed it.

journey.quote: The Hellenic National Meteorological Service's Naxos climatology, which does not state its averaging period, gives an August mean temperature of 25.0°C and a mean maximum of 27.0°C.
journey.reaction: Named source, admits what the source leaves out. That's how you cite something properly.

journey.quote: Milan is a city station, not a lakeside one.
journey.reaction: Honest. Most sites would pass off Milan figures as Como without saying so.

journey.quote: Are you open on 15 August, and do your suppliers charge differently that week?
journey.reaction: Useful. That's a question about money, which tells me someone thought about surcharges. I'd use this one.

journey.quote: Summer 2026 was the hottest in France since 1900, with a heatwave running from 28 July to 19 August 2026.
journey.reaction: Dated, sourced, and then they say it's only one summer. Not using it as a scare tactic. Fine.

journey.quote: Lisbon's climate normals for 1961 to 1990, supplied by IPMA
journey.reaction: Hang on, the other entries use 1971 to 2000 and this one uses 1961 to 1990. They do warn about mixed periods up top, but the article doesn't say these figures are older, and I only caught it because I check dates.

journey.quote: For June to August 2026, BMKG's Bali climate station rated the drought and wetness outlook across the province as generally "Normal and Slightly Dry".
journey.reaction: This was an outlook for one season that's already over. It tells me nothing about August next year, but the way it's placed, a less careful reader might take it as a general pattern. It should say it was for 2026 only.

journey.section: Southern winter and dry season escapes
journey.quote: For more planning reading, browse the Wedded Wonderland magazine.
journey.reaction: Filler link in the middle of the data. Doesn't hurt much but it's noise.

journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor confirms inclusions in writing before you commit.
journey.reaction: That's the kind of thing I want to hear. In writing, before commitment. After my last vendor, this matters.

journey.section: Plan your August wedding with Wedded Concierge
journey.quote: Whether your August is a Riviera dinner or a fire-lit lodge in New Zealand, it helps to have one person across every detail.
journey.reaction: This is where the tone switches to sales. 'It helps to have one person' is a feeling, not a fact. The next sentence is the useful one.

journey.section: Plan your August wedding with Wedded Concierge
journey.quote: One Wedded Advisor, start to finish, works in your time zone and quotes in AUD, and the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins.
journey.reaction: Fee agreed in writing up front is good. But what's the fee model? Flat, percentage? And do you take a cut from the venue? That's still my first question, and this page doesn't answer it.

unanswered_questions: How is the Wedded Concierge fee worked out: flat fee, percentage of budget, or something else?
Do you take commissions or referral fees from the venues and suppliers you recommend, and are supplier prices passed on at cost?
What does 'one we plan' mean in numbers: have you actually run August weddings at these destinations?
Can I see a real August wedding you planned at one of these places, with the actual budget?
Is the initial Wedded Concierge conversation obligation-free, and what happens after I submit my date and guest list?

turn_offs_found.quote: Whether your August is a Riviera dinner or a fire-lit lodge in New Zealand, it helps to have one person across every detail.
turn_offs_found.why: Emotional sales line after an article that was all evidence. It doesn't say anything I can check.

would_share_with: My fiancée, as a starting spreadsheet for Europe versus Fiji or Mauritius
A mate on r/weddingplanning who asked about August heat in Italy

cta_reaction.quote: Tell us your date and your guest list, and begin with Wedded Concierge.
cta_reaction.why: The content earned enough trust that I'd look at the Concierge page. I wouldn't hand over my date and guest list until I know how the fee works and whether you get paid by the venues. If the Concierge page answers that, I'll enquire.

top_3_changes: Bali: make it clear the outlook was for one past season. OLD: `rated the drought and wetness outlook across the province as generally "Normal and Slightly Dry".` NEW: `rated the drought and wetness outlook across the province as generally "Normal and Slightly Dry". That outlook covered 2026 only, not future years.`

Closing: cut the emotional line and lead with the facts. OLD: `Whether your August is a Riviera dinner or a fire-lit lodge in New Zealand, it helps to have one person across every detail. One Wedded Advisor, start to finish,` NEW: `Whether your August is a Riviera dinner or a fire-lit lodge in New Zealand, one Wedded Advisor, start to finish,`
Portugal: say outright that these normals are older than the others. OLD: `Lisbon's climate normals for 1961 to 1990` NEW: `Lisbon's older climate normals for 1961 to 1990`
